sprint.name: AE Sprint 26-09
sprint.goal: Churn reporting hardening plus platform maintenance.

fields.description:
Event-grain model over billing exports so subscription state changes are queryable without hand-joining the raw Stripe tables.

Grain: one row per subscription state transition.

comments.body: Model is green in prod. 2.1M rows, 14 dbt tests passing.
Handing to AE-418 for the Metabase layer.

fields.description:
Cohort retention view on top of fct_subscription_events for the CS team.
Dashboard: https://acme.metabase.acme.io/dashboard/311-churn-cohorts

comments.body: CS lead here — this replaces the manual retention sheet we have been maintaining since March. We will use it for the Q3 renewal review on 2026-09-08 instead of the spreadsheet.

fields.description: Cohort analysis is meaningless without history behind it.

comments.body: Backfill complete: 2025-02-01 through 2026-08-01 loaded. Cohorts now resolve 18 months back.

fields.summary: Rename usr_id to user_id in staging models
fields.description: Naming consistency with the style guide. No downstream consumers.

fields.summary: Spike: can we attribute trial signups to campaign?
fields.description: Timeboxed to two days. Growth asked whether attribution is feasible with what we already collect.

comments.body: Answer is no. campaign_id is stripped at the CDN edge before the event reaches our collector, so it is absent for 94% of trial signups. Not fixable in the warehouse.
Growth confirmed: we are deferring the attribution epic to Q4 and will scope a CDN change first. Saved us starting it this quarter.

fields.description: Rebuild rev-rec to handle mid-term plan changes.

comments.body: Blocked: need Finance to confirm whether deferred revenue is in scope for v2. Asked in #finance on 2026-08-13, no answer yet.
Still blocked, 9 days. This is on the critical path for the board reporting pack due end of Q3.

fields.description: Nightly was overrunning into business hours.

comments.body: Runtime down from 42 min to 11 min on the nightly run after partitioning the events source. Nightly now finishes before 06:00.

fields.description: Marketing asked for a dataset they can slice themselves.

comments.body: Dataset published. Not sure yet who on marketing picks this up — the original requester has left the team.
